name: obsidian-wiki
title_zh: 让 AI 代理用 Obsidian 搭建并维护你的数
tagline_zh: 别再让笔记散落各处。这套框架让 AI 代理按 wiki 结构持续整理、链接、更新你的知识库，越用越像你自己的外脑。
tagline_en: Stop scattered notes. This framework lets AI agents continuously organize, link, and refresh your Obsidian.
desc_en: Framework for AI agents to build and maintain a digital brain through Obsidian wiki
why_zh: 不是一次性导入，而是给代理一套「维护协议」：自动补链接、拆旧建新、按 wiki 规范迭代。
why_en: Not a one-shot import—it's a maintenance protocol: auto-linking, refactoring, and wiki-rule iteration, so the vault grows with.
limit_zh: 只认 Obsidian 的 Markdown 与 wiki 链接语法；非本地 vault（如网页剪藏）需先转格式。
limit_en: Only Obsidian Markdown & wiki links; web clippings need conversion first. Agent needs file write access, else it only suggests, never saves.
